instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot. Inside a gym with large windows in the background, the man in the black t-shirt (R1) stands on the left, facing right in a defensive stance. The shirtless man with a mullet (R2) lunges forward from the right, extending his arm to throw a punch. Both wear white shin guards and protective glasses. In the background, a group of about four bystanders, including a man in a grey t-shirt, stand watching the sparring session. The lighting is bright and even.
elements: R2 lunges forward toward R1 to throw a punch
R1 faces R2 in a defensive stance
R2 extends his arm as the attacker while R1 is the defender
R1 and R2 wear white shin guards
R1 and R2 wear protective glasses
the sparring session takes place inside a gym with large windows
